comment: 40yo male, HIV-positive on ART (CD4 nadir 280, currently 410 on TDF/FTC/DTG with suppressed VL) AND HHV-8 (KSHV) seropositive on routine screening. No current Kaposi sarcoma / multicentric Castleman disease (MCD) / primary effusion lymphoma (PEL) diagnosis. HHV-8 IARC Group 1 carcinogen — etiologic driver of all three lymphoproliferative outcomes. No curative antiviral; prevention pathway = restoration / optimization of cellular immunity + mucocutaneous + oral + GI awareness + lymph-node surveillance. Engine fires RF-CHRONIC-HHV8-MALIGNANCY-PREVENTION (any_of: hhv8_serology:positive OR kshv_serology:positive OR hhv8_status_in_immunocompromised:positive) and routes to PreventionPlan: standard = ART optimization (HIV VL kept suppressed; CD4 recovery prioritized) + skin/oral/GI/lymph-node surveillance schedule + dermatology baseline q6-12mo; alternative = symptom-triggered evaluation only. Validates v0.3 HHV-8 prevention pilot. Anchored DIS-KAPOSI; MCD + PEL covered via prose rationale.
